data.name: Walker
data.long_meaning: The name Walker is derived from the Old English word 'wealcian' or 'wucan', which means 'to move, to go, or to walk'. It became a popular surname in England and was eventually adopted as a given name in the English-speaking world. The name is a reflection of the journey of life and the idea of moving forward towards one's goals and aspirations.
